payloads.name: ezRemote Client · PS5 · Download app loader
payloads.description: Manage PS5 files and transfers with the console client. Requires websrv running on the PS5; follow the loader and client installation instructions for this release.

payloads.name: Garlic SaveMgr
payloads.description: Back up and browse PS5 saves through a browser interface. Load the ELF with elfldr, then open the console’s port 8082 from a device on your local network.

payloads.name: ftpsrv · PS5
payloads.description: FTP server payload for a jailbroken PS5 with a compatible ELF loader. Connect from an FTP client on your local network to port 2121.

payloads.name: websrv · PS5
payloads.description: Run the PS5 homebrew web interface, browser-based file access and app launcher on port 8080. Requires an existing compatible ELF loader.

payloads.name: klogsrv · PS5
payloads.description: Stream console kernel logs to a local-network client on port 3232 for homebrew troubleshooting. Use the PS5 ELF build.

payloads.name: ELF Loader · PS5
payloads.description: Background ELF payload loader that accepts payloads on port 9021. Start it through the compatible initial loader described by the project.
